card.name: Closing points in references and tables
card.fires_on: Mixed spots: the end of a citation year or page range, a number or symbol inside a dosing table, and the middle of capitalized drug names split into pieces.

modes.label: Citation endings
modes.description: Final digit or closing parenthesis of a year or page range in a reference list.

modes.label: Table cells
modes.description: A number, percent sign, or 'to' inside interaction or dosing tables.

modes.label: Inside capitalized drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of an all-caps brand or generic drug name.

card.plain: It fires on scattered small pieces: the end of a citation, a cell in a dosing table, or the middle of a drug name in capitals.
